title: Moab's Rebellion and the Campaign of the Three Kings
description: King Joram of Israel allies with King Jehoshaphat of Judah and the king of Edom to crush Mesha's rebellion in Moab. After a seven-day detour through the wilderness of Edom, the army has no water, but the prophet Elisha declares that the Lord will fill the valley with water and deliver Moab into their hands. In the morning, the Moabites see the water red as blood and think the kings have killed each other. They rush forward to plunder, but are driven back. The Israelites ravage the land until only Kir-Hareseth remains. Then the king of Moab sacrifices his firstborn son as a burnt offering on the wall, and great wrath comes upon Israel so that they withdraw.
